notes.title: Update: new languages
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10135204/d2d064f390209263baa2d42d5e4d76755e25ad44.png

New Languages
7 new languages appeared - German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch and Simplified Chinese. Great work of translators. Hope it helps more people to become real Bravelanders.

Braveland Wizard improved
All difficulties revamped, spell system improved, fast battle mode added. And many more. Just try it.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/333880/Braveland_Wizard/

notes.title: Update: Fast Battle Mode
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10135204/7bd76aff508495209e2451fc377ac20ef49d4953.png

Hi, Bravelanders!

Fast animations mode
We've added fast battle mode that speeds up all animations! So you can play the game at your own pace. We've tested new mode and it's gorgeous. Almost faster than light. :)

Grind issues in Braveland Wizard fixed
This week we've fixed grind issues in Braveland Wizard. Hurray! No more repetitive battles. Dungeons give you more gold to hire new troops. Start of the game is easier. That fixes affects all three difficulties so you can try it and say us is it ok or not.

In case you forgot what Braveland Wizard is:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/333880/Braveland_Wizard/

Thanks for reading this post to the end. Have a nice day!
